content: Admission Inquiry Academics / KSS Physics Krishna School of Science builds physics capability through conceptual depth, quantitative reasoning, and modern scientific exploration. 0 Years UG Duration (NEP) 0 Core Domain Areas 0 Higher Study Paths 0 Career Clusters LEADERSHIP NOTE Message From the HOD KSS Dr. Tejas Pandya Assistant Professor & HoD Physics tejaspandya.kss@kpgu.ac.in ABOUT DEPARTMENT Physics Education Across Fundamental and Applied Domains 01 B.Sc. in Physics is offered as a 4-year undergraduate program under NEP (8 semesters), focusing on conceptual understanding, analytical reasoning, and practical skills in physics. 02 Physics examines matter, energy, space, and time from elementary particles to the universe. The core objective is to understand how physical systems and processes work through scientific principles and evidence. 03 The department offers exposure to Material Science, Quantum Physics, Nuclear Physics, Mathematical Physics, Space Physics, and Electronics. Material science in particular supports interdisciplinary exploration, synthesis, and characterization of next-generation materials with potential industrial and societal applications. VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission 01 The Department strives to deliver undergraduate teaching in a meaningful manner and create an environment where students are able to discover their potentials. Besides ensuring the availability of prescribed books and supplementary reading material, the department motivates students towards consistent library work. In order to enrich learning experience of students, faculty members use best-in-line ICT facilities. 02 To make imperative commitments in regions like workforce, present day labs, and show a significant degree of skill in the investigation of Designing Material science and to put together and support productive working frameworks in the Division for acknowledgment of our targets as Organization of prominence and Global norms. 01 Procure quality teaching-learning, research and service opportunities leading to holistic development of students through collusive exchange of ideas, unallied thought, and the highest ethical standards. 02 Serve high quality academic experiences through comprehensive & relevant curriculum at UG levels. 03 Foster research aptitude by extending infrastructural support and research guidance. 04 Inculcate the values of multi-disciplinary and inter-disciplinary approach and innovative thinking by promoting learning experiences in the field of chemical sciences and its allied fields. 05 Fruitage knowledgeable graduates for careers in academia, industry and GOs/NGOs. 06 Promote an ethical and professional environment amongst faculties and students of the department. SCOPE OF PROGRAM B.Sc. (Hons. with Research) Physics Pathways 01 After B.Sc. (Hons.) Physics, students can pursue higher studies or jobs and internships for electronics and material science industry readiness. 02 Startup pathways are increasingly viable due to favorable innovation and entrepreneurship initiatives. 03 Graduates can prepare for civil service and other government-sector examinations. 04 Students completing M.Sc. in Physics branches can pursue Ph.D. programs and advanced research tracks; under NEP norms, high-performing students may directly transition into doctoral pathways through national eligibility exams.
